ache.title: A clever deck can turn into a card hunt
ache.note: Nero shows a Machamp EX deck with a Meowth twist, Old Amber shields and Trainer cards like Sabrina. Deck guides are fun puzzles. They also give you a shopping list, and missing one EX card can make you open pack after pack. Build with what you have before you chase what you don’t.
watch: a deck list as a shopping list
missing one EX card bugging you
ache.tip: Build the closest version with cards you own. A swapped card is fine; a chase isn’t.
lines: a cat and a muscle man. iconic
missing a card? swap it, done

videoData.title: Meowchamp EX: the Secret Meta | Pokémon TCG Pocket

textData.text: In today's video, I delve into the intriguing Meowchamp EX deck, focusing on Meowth's role in powering up Machamp. I start with the basics of Machop, Machoke, and Machamp EX, and then reveal the twist - the inclusion of Meowth, instead of Dugtrio or Marowak EX. I discuss the strategy, including the use of Old Amber for shielding and essential Trainer cards like Professor Research and Sabrina. Watch as I test the deck in a real game scenario, tackle the Starmie EX matchup, and explore tactical decisions that can turn the tide in battle. Join me on stream for more exciting gameplay.
